note: Generated by test/make-rs256-vector.mjs. Every key here is a SYNTHETIC TEST KEY made by that script, not an Apier key, and every certificate is made-up test data. Do not edit by hand.

cases.name: rs256-current
cases.note: A production-style RS256 certificate under the current key.

cases.name: rs256-current-sandbox-allowed
cases.note: Allowing sandbox certificates does not refuse a production one.

cases.name: rs256-retired
cases.note: A retired key still checks the certificates it signed.

cases.name: rs256-apex-issuer
cases.note: The apex issuer that older certificates carry.

cases.name: rs256-no-freshness
cases.note: A certificate from before November 2026 has no freshness member: stale is unknown.

cases.name: rs256-stale
cases.note: freshness.stale is reported, never judged.

cases.name: rs256-duplicate-kid
cases.note: Two keys share a kid: the first one in the set is used, and it is not the signer.

cases.name: rs256-retired-mark-empty
cases.note: An empty apier_retired_at is no mark.

cases.name: rs256-retired-mark-unreadable
cases.note: A retirement mark that is not a date still marks the key retired.

cases.name: compromised-issued-after
cases.note: issued_at after apier_compromised_at.

cases.name: compromised-issued-before
cases.note: issued_at before apier_compromised_at: still refused, because the leaked key signed that date.

cases.name: compromised-issued-at-the-mark
cases.note: issued_at exactly equal to apier_compromised_at.

cases.name: compromised-mark-unreadable
cases.note: apier_compromised_at is null: the member alone marks the key.

cases.name: compromised-and-tampered
cases.note: A compromised key and a changed certificate: compromised_key comes first in the order.

cases.name: issuer-other-environment
cases.note: A valid signature over another issuer is not a production certificate.

cases.name: issuer-missing
cases.note: No issuer member.

cases.name: issuer-trailing-slash
cases.note: The issuer is compared exactly.

cases.name: typ-jwt
cases.note: A valid signature under typ JWT is not a certificate.

cases.name: typ-key-history
cases.note: The key history typ is not a certificate typ.

cases.name: typ-uppercase
cases.note: typ is compared exactly.

cases.name: alg-hs256-public-key-as-secret
cases.note: HS256 with the public key as the secret.

cases.name: alg-none-with-signature
cases.note: alg none over a real signature.

cases.name: alg-ps256
cases.note: Another RSA algorithm is not accepted.

cases.name: alg-rs256-lowercase
cases.note: alg is compared exactly.

cases.name: kid-unknown
cases.note: No key in the set has this kid.

cases.name: kid-of-ed25519-key-as-rs256
cases.note: A kid that exists only as a sandbox Ed25519 key, named by an RS256 header: the key is never used as an RSA key.

cases.name: kid-of-rsa-key-as-eddsa

cases.name: key-alg-member-differs
cases.note: The key says it is for another algorithm.

cases.name: key-rsa-1024
cases.note: A validly signed certificate under a 1024-bit key: the key is not usable.

cases.name: key-rsa-exponent-one
cases.note: A key with public exponent 1 would accept the padded message as its own signature.

cases.name: key-ed25519-short
cases.note: An Ed25519 key of 31 bytes.

cases.name: key-ed25519-noncanonical
cases.note: An Ed25519 key that is not the canonical encoding of a point.

cases.name: sandbox-synthetic-not-allowed

cases.name: rsa-key-marked-sandbox
cases.note: An RSA key carrying apier_sandbox is a sandbox key and never checks a production certificate.

cases.name: sandbox-claim-under-production-key-not-allowed

cases.name: sandbox-issuer-not-checked

cases.name: payload-not-canonical

cases.name: signature-for-another-certificate
